name: Falcon 40B

release_date.note: HF repo createdAt; the series paper's arXiv v1 is 2023-11-28

params.note: derived from config with tied embeddings; the checkpoint also stores lm_head, giving 41,835,970,560 = index total_size / 2; card: 40B

tokenizer.note: trained by TII; vocabulary fits in 16-bit ids

steps.label: attention and MLP read the same input, each through its own LayerNorm
128 query heads x 64, 8 KV heads, RoPE

specials.name: parallel_block
specials.what: attention and MLP in parallel with two separate LayerNorms (Falcon-7B later used one)

specials.name: no_biases
specials.what: no biases in linear layers; LayerNorms keep theirs

paper.title: The Falcon Series of Open Language Models
paper.note: section 5.1 summary, 5.2.1 (separate layer norms, tied embeddings), Table 16; arXiv API: v1 2023-11-28

card.note: Apache 2.0; rotary; 'multiquery' with independent keys and values per tensor-parallel degree; parallel attention/MLP with two layer norms; 60 layers, d_model 8192, vocab 65024, sequence length 2048

code.note: new_decoder_architecture with num_ln_in_parallel_attn 2: ln_attn and ln_mlp on the same input; mlp_output += attention_output; then residual

ccode.note: activation default 'gelu'; ffn_hidden_size default 4 * hidden_size; tie_word_embeddings default True

rope.note: default_theta 10000.0 when config sets no rope_theta

idx.note: ln_attn, ln_mlp; no linear biases; total_size 83,671,941,120 bytes (bf16)

count.note: V*d + L*(4d + d*(nq + 2*nkv)*hd + nq*hd*d + 2*d*f) + 2d with V 65024, d 8192, nq 128, nkv 8, hd 64, f 32768, L 60

figure_links.author: TII
figure_links.title: Figure 5 of the Falcon paper: parallel attention and MLP blocks

unknowns.tokenizer.kind: the paper and card do not name the tokenizer algorithm

notes: Card says 'multiquery'; config and paper Table 16 give 8 KV heads. The card explains keys and values are kept per tensor-parallel degree (TP 8). The record follows config: GQA with 8 groups.
Paper calls the scheme multigroup attention, an extension of multiquery.
